attempts.prompt: Pixel art animation sprite sheet of exactly the SAME male villager in reference: dark blue hair, ochre tunic, cream sleeves, dark trousers, brown boots. Transparent background. Strict layout: 4 columns, 4 rows, exactly 16 full-body sprites; evenly spaced identical cells. Rows 1 and 2 together are one complete EIGHT-frame walk toward bottom-right, front three-quarter view. Rows 3 and 4 together are one complete EIGHT-frame walk toward top-right, back three-quarter view. Each cycle read left to right then next row. Draw a genuine full gait: frame 0 near-foot forward contact, 1 knees bend downward, 2 far knee passes supporting leg, 3 far knee rises forward, 4 far-foot forward contact, 5 opposite knees bend downward, 6 near knee passes supporting leg, 7 near knee rises forward. No four-frame repeated loop. Darker far limbs distinguish the two halves. Four key poses AND four intermediate poses, each different silhouette, smooth changes of knees and feet. Identical head, torso, outfit and proportions throughout, minimal head bob. All sprites point toward RIGHT, top pair front view, bottom pair back view. No text, no grid lines, no background, no ground shadows. Preserve reference pixel-art style exactly. Do not add rows or columns.

attempts.prompt: Create an animation IN-BETWEEN pose sheet for exactly the villager in the reference (blue-black hair, ochre tunic, cream sleeves, dark pants, brown boots). Each row contains ONLY these FOUR different transitional walk poses: (1) LOWERED body, front supporting knee visibly BENT, rear heel lifted; (2) RAISED body, opposite thigh lifted FORWARD with bent knee, supporting leg trailing; (3) LOWERED body again, opposite supporting knee visibly BENT, first foot behind with heel lifted; (4) RAISED body, first thigh lifted FORWARD with bent knee, other leg trailing. These are DOWN / UP / OPPOSITE DOWN / OPPOSITE UP in-between poses, not extended-stride contact poses. Knees MUST bend, don't draw straight spread legs in any frame. Darken farther limbs so opposite phases remain visibly different. All top 4 show face and shirt front; all bottom 4 show back of hair and shirt back. Consistent head position and body dimensions. No words, no cell lines, no shadows, no additional people.
